Welcome to my YouTube channel!
Here, I share everything you need to know about physiotherapy, health, and medical education to help you better understand your body and improve your quality of life.

What you’ll find on this channel:
✔ Practical exercises for recovery and maintaining your health
✔ Useful tips for a healthier lifestyle
✔ Insights into my approach and working methods as a physiotherapist
✔ Medical imaging interpretation explained in a simple and clear way

If you’re ready to learn how to take care of your body and discover effective recovery and prevention methods, subscribe and join our community!
